name: @luminary-media-converter/electron
description: Desktop shell: hosts the Encoding API in the main process and the web client as its renderer

scripts.dist:mac: npm run fetch-binaries && npm run build:workspaces && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: npm run fetch-binaries win32-x64 && npm run build:workspaces && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack: npm run fetch-binaries && npm run build:workspaces && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
